title: Thermal Instability
topic: Explore the conditions for condensation through linear theory.
scope: Figures 1–3: stability domains, condensation growth (alpha=1/2), and wave growth (alpha=-2), with gamma=5/3. Equation-based reproductions with 15 map checks, 10 condensation checks, and 24 wave checks. Printed boundaries and curves have not been digitized for a pointwise comparison.

title: Cosmic-Ray Heating of the Interstellar Gas
topic: From heating and cooling balance to two coexisting phases.
scope: Historical heating/cooling diagnostics and a reduced 10–2,000 K cold-branch calculation with explicit assumptions. Numerical checks do not establish reproduction of the Letter’s equilibrium Figures 1 and 2.

title: Formation of Clouds in a Cooling Interstellar Medium
topic: Follow the formation of clouds in a cooling medium.
scope: Time-dependent evolution is a candidate exhibit. We will first review ionization, perturbations, and boundary conditions.

title: Molecular Cloud Formation in Shock-Compressed Layers
topic: From shock-compressed layers to molecular cloud formation.
scope: Locate original code and data, then select target figures and define the scope of a new implementation.

title: An Origin of Supersonic Motions in Interstellar Clouds
topic: Explore structure formation and cloud motions in two dimensions.
scope: Candidate exhibits include figures, animations, and statistical diagnostics. Original materials and computational requirements will be reviewed.

title: The Field Condition: A New Constraint on Spatial Resolution in Simulations of the Nonlinear Development of Thermal Instability
topic: Examine numerical convergence through thermal conduction and spatial resolution.
scope: Candidate exhibits compare simulations with and without thermal conduction across different spatial resolutions.

title: The Neutral Atomic Phases of the Interstellar Medium
topic: Photoelectric heating by small grains and PAHs, X-ray/cosmic-ray ionization, and atomic phase equilibrium.
scope: Audit the heating/cooling terms and identify a local equilibrium curve for a modest-cost calculation.
review_status: Bibliography and abstract checked; equations, data availability, and target figures require an individual audit.

title: Neutral Atomic Phases of the Interstellar Medium in the Galaxy
topic: Revised atomic-gas microphysics and the allowed two-phase pressure range across the Galactic disk.
scope: Compare physical inputs with the 1995 model before attempting an equilibrium calculation.
review_status: Bibliography and abstract checked; equations, data availability, and target figures require an individual audit.

title: A Simple and Accurate Network for Hydrogen and Carbon Chemistry in the Interstellar Medium
topic: A compact chemical network with an author-maintained public PDR implementation and rate corrections.
scope: Pin a corrected rate/code version, inspect units and validity ranges, then choose a small chemical or thermal benchmark.
review_status: Bibliography and abstract checked; equations, data availability, and target figures require an individual audit.

authors: Gong, Ho, Stone, Ostriker, Caselli, Grassi, C.-G. Kim, J.-G. Kim & Halevi
title: Implementation of Chemistry in the Athena++ Code
topic: A public chemistry framework including GOW17, general KIDA networks, and coupled thermal/chemical evolution.
scope: Begin with published tests, public inputs, or a small one-zone/1D case; full 3D runs are optional.
review_status: Bibliography and abstract checked; equations, data availability, and target figures require an individual audit.

title: Structure and Stability of Phase Transition Layers in the Interstellar Medium
topic: CNM/WNM fronts, evaporation and condensation, and corrugational stability.
scope: Candidate: a plane-parallel front or the linear growth relation, after checking boundary conditions.
review_status: Bibliography and abstract checked; equations, data availability, and target figures require an individual audit.

title: The Role of Ambipolar Diffusion in the Formation Process of Moderately Magnetized Diffuse Clouds
topic: Two-fluid condensation and the competition between magnetic flux accumulation and ambipolar diffusion.
scope: Candidate: the analytic field-strength estimate or a small 1D verification case.
review_status: Bibliography and abstract checked; equations, data availability, and target figures require an individual audit.

title: Two-Fluid MHD Simulations of Converging H I Flows in the Interstellar Medium. I: Methodology and Basic Results
topic: Two-fluid coupling and magnetic limits on condensation in converging atomic flows.
scope: Document the method and inputs; consider a coupling benchmark or analysis of available outputs rather than a full 2D rerun.
review_status: Bibliography and abstract checked; equations, data availability, and target figures require an individual audit.

title: Two-Fluid MHD Simulations of Converging H I Flows in the Interstellar Medium. II: Are Molecular Clouds Generated Directly from a Warm Neutral Medium?
topic: The angle between inflow and mean magnetic field affects shocked atomic gas and cloud formation.
scope: Compare model assumptions and published diagnostics; reanalyse public outputs if available. Large runs are outside the initial scope.
review_status: Bibliography and abstract checked; equations, data availability, and target figures require an individual audit.

title: Formation of Turbulent and Magnetized Molecular Clouds via Accretion Flows of H I Clouds
topic: Three-dimensional MHD with chemistry, conduction, and accretion of inhomogeneous atomic gas.
scope: Focus on setup documentation, analysis methods, and any available snapshots. Do not require rerunning the full 3D calculation.
review_status: Bibliography and abstract checked; equations, data availability, and target figures require an individual audit.

title: Self-similar solutions for the dynamical condensation of a radiative gas layer
topic: Non-equilibrium thermal condensation described by a family of plane-parallel similarity solutions.
scope: Candidate: similarity profiles and limiting scalings, using an ODE solver and a small 1D comparison.
review_status: Bibliography and abstract checked; equations, data availability, and target figures require an individual audit.

title: Fragmentation of a dynamically condensing radiative layer

review_status: Bibliography and abstract checked; equations, data availability, and target figures require an individual audit.

title: Structure of dynamical condensation fronts in the interstellar medium
topic: Condensation-front families parameterized by pressure and mass flux, with cooling- and Field-length regimes.

review_status: Bibliography and abstract checked; equations, data availability, and target figures require an individual audit.

topic: Thermal conduction, phase transitions, viscosity, and kinetic-energy transfer in a bistable medium.
scope: Prioritize published energy budgets and analysis of available outputs. A small front problem can isolate the mechanism without reproducing the full 2D run.
